reconstruction_notes: Concept pedipalps too large and some legs overlap. Author exactly eight well-separated walking legs plus visibly shorter simple pedipalps; smooth a few abdomen plate transitions, preserve segmentation. Spinnerets simplified. Tail curvature, colour and eye placement artistic; no sex-exact or taxonomic placement assertion.

description.en: Low domed front body, narrow waist, oval visibly segmented abdomen and long slender gently curved whip-like tail; eight articulated walking legs in four pairs, two smaller simple pedipalps at front, subtle rear underside spinneret projections. Warm walnut/russet/sand palette, modest natural dark eyes. No scorpion sting, pincers, horror spikes or web.
